column1: # Findings pinned for the shipped sample configurations of the lightweight connector (data-driven test ConfigKeyPinTest).
# file: path relative to the sink-connector-lightweight module directory.
# Only keys with a finding are listed; every other key of the file must be known (no finding).
# expected: the finding kind reported by ConfigKeyCheck. Under the default mode each finding is a WARN and nothing is refused.
# Under strict mode (config.keys.strict=true) the UNKNOWN and RENAMED rows refuse the start; RENAMED_IGNORED and IGNORED rows do not.
